aligned_to_test.rule: train reference = test reference * min(train samples) / min(test samples), measured alternately on one node

calibration.method: min over 5 runs of building the unified CNF and solving it with RC2 for these instances; factor clamped to [0.67, 1.5]

limit_selection.note: Selected in hardening job 1 with the earlier fresh-solver reference. After restoring the paper's incremental RC2 enumeration (the authors' oracle.py) the budget is kept at 10 s: re-applying the rule would push it to 2.5 s, where interpreter start-up and formula construction dominate. Headroom is carried by the scale-stress tier.
limit_selection.rule: largest candidate budget at which the reference localises <= 75.0% of the public TRAIN instances (keeps headroom); smallest candidate if none
